h: Exile Refines Israel for the Renewal of Torah

p: In the haftarah of this parshah (Yeshayahu 1:24–26):
"Ah, I will be consoled over My adversaries
and avenge Myself of My enemies," etc.;
"and I will smelt away your dross as with lye,
and I will restore your judges as at first,
and your counselors as at the beginning."
in the name of the Pesikta:
"And I will restore your judges as at first"
"and your counselors as at the beginning"
Now the meaning of "My adversaries," tzarai,
they distressed and oppressed them most,
like a fetus in its mother's womb.
was a preparation for the Giving of the Torah;
that through them they would merit the Torah,
And then, when the time came
for the revelation of the Torah in the world,
there was first the wisdom of Egypt,
for wisdom was there in exile;
and they merited the Giving of the Torah
And likewise in the exile of Bavel,
there began the essence and root
of the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh;
have seen a great light," etc.;
"'He has set me in dark places'
this is the Talmud of Bavel."
And likewise in the exile of Persia,
there were the Men of the Great Assembly,
and all the fences and decrees
are from the Men of the Great Assembly;
more than You decreed upon me."
"to destroy, to kill and to annihilate" (Esther 3:13),
and not to make them transgress the religion.
the holding of the mountain over them like a barrel,
as is written (in Midrash Tanchuma Noach, there),
whereas the Written Torah they accepted
and said "We will do and we will hear."
וְאִיתָא (מִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים ד, ד)
And it is stated (Midrash Rabbah Shir HaShirim 4:4):
"In her destruction she raised up tzaddikim for Me:
"thus, the tzaddikim you raised up for Me
you raised up for Me in her building."
"Ah, I will be consoled over My adversaries"
in which there was immediately the consolation,
of the analysis of Torah she'b'al peh,
who was of the remnants of the Great Assembly;
For in Bavel there were still prophets;
when it was then the time
for the revelation of the Written Torah,
there was opposite it in the kelipah
but from the powers of impurity;
where among the Men of the Great Assembly there were
but by the powers of impurity.
the main spread of Torah she'b'al peh
from the intellect of the Sages,
שֶׁהָיָה גַּם כֵּן עַל פִּי שֵׂכֶל שֶׁלָּהֶם
which was also according to their intellect.
הָיָה בּוֹ גַּם כֵּן נִיצוֹץ מוּעָט
there was also a small spark
from which there extracted from them
But the essence of their wisdom
and they wanted to instill this
And likewise the kingdom of Greece decreed
to make them transgress the religion;
and likewise in the exile of Edom
And this is the meaning of
that they are called enemies of Hashem,
and of them Hashem Yisbarach says:

p: "And I will smelt away your dross as with lye,
And the point is that "your dross"
there are found among the nations
that is, that they become haughty.
But the Torah is the opposite,
for it is likened to water,
and goes to a low place,
and "Where — me'ayin — shall wisdom be found?" (Iyov 28:12)
only in one who makes himself
as though he does not exist
And this is what it says:
and as is written in Rashi's commentary
on the Gemara there as well:
"And I will restore your judges as at first"
and it corresponds to the Written Torah,
which is the portion of Moshe Rabbeinu;
and of Aharon it is written (Shemos 4:16):
"He shall be a mouth for you";
that is, what is clear to the intellect
and known to be from Hashem Yisbarach,
and everything written in a sefer
is akin to the Written Torah,
in the Shulchan Aruch and the poskim
and this corresponds to what is said:
"I will be consoled over My adversaries."
And the point is that David
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַב הָאֲרִ״י הַקָּדוֹשׁ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה
as the holy Arizal, of blessed memory, wrote;
as is written in the holy Zohar
and it is the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh,
as a halachah l'Moshe mi'Sinai in accordance with him";
for it is like a halachah without a reason,
and only to Moshe Rabbeinu was the reason revealed;
and he has understanding in the heart
and this is through Ruach HaKodesh,
which is called the wisdom of Shlomo,
the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh;
it is what the intellect can grasp;
it is that one feels in the heart
that thus it ought to be;
"Behold, You desire truth in the inward parts,
and in the hidden part You make me know wisdom";
that it is "in the hidden part,"
And this is what is said (Yeshayahu 28:29):
on which the world is founded";
and all speech has nothing tangible,
And it may be according to what it says
that is, a person does not understand
from where it came to him,
that it fell into his mind,
and he merited to arrive at
And this is "He is wondrous in counsel,
at which a person is astonished,
and on which the world is founded.
was created with words of Torah,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (רֵישׁ בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה, א, א)
as is written (beginning of Bereishis Rabbah, 1:1):
and afterward, "in His goodness He renews
this is through the origination of halachah
And after the Giving of the Torah,
the origination of halachah was handed over to the Sages,
and it is what Hashem Yisbarach
shines into the heart of the Sages
And for this reason the Sages are called
who are engaged in the building of the world
And this is that the world
for this is the building of the world.
And this is what it says:
"and your counselors as at the beginning"
who are the root of Torah she'b'al peh,
from the primordial light that was hidden,
this is revealed to the Sages.
as is stated in Sefer HaBahir:
and placed it for them in its place"
it is the time of the revelation
which corresponds to the middah of Malchus:
we call it Torah she'b'al peh
